problem: Kwame keeps 14 seashells in a jar. At the beach his aunt finds 9 more for him. What is the number of seashells in Kwame's jar now?

problem: A toy box at the daycare held some blocks. In the morning the children tossed in 37 more, and by noon the box held 85 blocks. How many blocks were in the box to start with?

problem: By sunset, the fishing boat had 85 fish in its hold, after the crew caught 37 during the day. What number of fish were in the hold before the day began?

problem: Fourteen musicians were tuning up on stage when 8 more walked out to join them. The stage lights were very bright. How many musicians are on stage?

problem: The library smelled of new books. How many readers are at story time if 14 were sitting on the rug and 8 more came in late?

problem: Train car 42 left the station with 17 travellers, and 9 more climbed in at the first town. How many travellers are in the train car now?

problem: How many people are on ferry 42 after it leaves the dock with 17 people and picks up 9 more at the island?

problem: There were 12 shoppers in the bakery queue. A little later the queue had 30 shoppers. How many shoppers joined the queue?

problem: The farmers' market was very noisy that morning. After Mrs. Osei put 16 more melons on her table, there were 40 melons on it. How many melons were on the table before?

problem: Uncle Rafael picked 14 more apples from his 6 trees, and his bucket now has 31 apples. How many apples were in the bucket before he picked them?

problem: Captain Lund's boat now carries 31 crabs. He caught 14 of them this morning with his 6 traps. What number of crabs were on the boat before this morning?

problem: Arjun bought 5 comic books at the fair and later went back for 4 more. How many comic books did he buy?

problem: Ms. Dube put 7 jars of jam on the pantry shelf, and now the shelf holds 20 jars. How many jars were on the shelf before?

problem: There are 20 pencils in the art cup after Theo dropped in 7 new ones. How many pencils were in the cup before Theo added his?

problem: Twelve geese were floating on the lake when 9 more paddled over from the reeds. The sun was setting behind the hill. How many geese are on the lake now?

problem: It was a cold morning in the village. How many people are waiting at the bus stop, if 12 were standing there and 9 more walked up?

problem: After 6 more children sat down, the lunch table had 15 children altogether. Find how many children were at the table before.

problem: Birds pecked at Zoe's sunflowers, so only 47 heads were left in the front garden. Zoe grew another patch at the back, and 36 more sunflowers bloomed there. How many sunflowers does Zoe have now?
follow_up_questions: She cuts a dozen sunflowers for her teacher. How many sunflowers does she keep?

problem: How many potatoes does Grandpa have now? Mice got into his first sack and only 47 good potatoes were left, but he dug up 36 more from the field.
follow_up_questions: He gives a dozen potatoes to the family next door. How many potatoes does he keep?

problem: Jamal was collecting eggs on his uncle's farm. His basket held 13 eggs when he went into the second hen house, which has 4 windows. After collecting there, he had 31 eggs. How many eggs came from the second hen house?
How many conkers did Freddie find under the second chestnut tree, if he had 13 when he left the first tree, walked 4 minutes to the next one, and went home with 31?

A few children were sitting on the story rug. When the librarian opened a new book, 5 more children came over from the shelves. Now 13 children are on the rug. How many were there before the story began?
follow_up_questions: Each child gets 2 stickers after the story. How many stickers are needed?
The sticker sheet has 40 stickers. How many will be left over?

problem: There are now 13 swimmers in the lake, because 5 more ran in from the beach when the sun came out. How many swimmers were in the lake before?
follow_up_questions: The lifeguard hands each swimmer 2 floats. How many floats does she hand out?
She had 40 floats in her shed. How many floats are left in the shed?

problem: Fatima and her grandmother were walking to the top of a lighthouse. They climbed 58 steps, then rested at a little window to look at the sea. After that they climbed another 37 steps to the top. How many steps did they climb in all?
follow_up_questions: On the way down they took a lift for 49 of the steps. How many steps did they walk down?

problem: How far did the snail crawl altogether, if it went 58 centimetres along the garden wall, rested under a leaf, and then crawled 37 centimetres more?
follow_up_questions: On the way back it took a shortcut that saved 49 centimetres. How far did it crawl back?

problem: Kenji picked 16 strawberries in the first row of the field. He wanted a full basket, so he kept picking along the next row. Now he has 30 strawberries in all. How many did he pick in the next row?
follow_up_questions: He gives half of his strawberries to his little sister. How many strawberries does Kenji keep?
His sister already had 7 strawberries of her own. How many strawberries does she have now?
They put all their strawberries into one bowl. How many strawberries are in the bowl?

problem: In all, Amina has 30 acorns now. She found 16 by the old oak, and the rest by the pond. How many did she find by the pond?
follow_up_questions: She gives half of her acorns to her cousin. How many acorns does Amina keep?
Her cousin already had 7 acorns. How many does her cousin have now?
They tip all their acorns into one basket. How many acorns are in the basket?

problem: Leila is learning magic tricks. At the start of the holidays she knew 7 tricks. Her uncle gave her a magic set with 40 cards, and now she can do 15 tricks. How many new tricks has she learned these holidays?
follow_up_questions: She wants to know 20 tricks by her birthday show. How many more tricks does she need to learn?

problem: How many new words has Tomas learned in Spanish class this month? He knew 7 words at the start, his book has 40 pictures, and now he knows 15 words.
follow_up_questions: He wants to know 20 words by the end of the month. How many more words must he learn?

problem: The craft fair opened at 9 in the morning. By lunchtime, 46 stalls were set up in the square. In the afternoon a van brought 23 more stalls from the next town. How many stalls were in the square by the afternoon?
follow_up_questions: The mayor visited 30 stalls before her tea break. How many stalls did she still have to visit?
After the break she visited 25 more. How many stalls were still waiting for her?

problem: How many paintings hung in the gallery by evening? By noon 46 paintings were up, the gallery shuts at 9, and in the afternoon an artist brought in 23 more.
follow_up_questions: The judges looked at 30 paintings before stopping for tea. How many paintings did they still have to look at?
After tea they looked at 25 more. How many paintings were still waiting?

problem: Autumn is when lots of people buy rakes, so the hardware store ordered more. On Tuesday there were 28 rakes in the rack. After the delivery on Thursday, the rack held 75 rakes. How many rakes came in the delivery?
follow_up_questions: Over the weekend, 19 rakes were sold. How many rakes are in the rack now?

problem: How many tins of paint did the delivery van bring to the art shop, if the shop had 28 tins on Monday and 75 after the van came on Wednesday?
follow_up_questions: Over the weekend, painters bought 19 tins. How many tins are left in the shop?

problem: Ella's dad had hung some paper lanterns in the garden for the summer party. He hung 14 more, so now there are 32 lanterns. Ella's favourite food is mango. How many lanterns were hanging at first?
follow_up_questions: The wind tore 5 lanterns down. How many lanterns are still hanging?
At the end of the party, Ella gave 8 lanterns to her friends to take home. How many were left hanging?

problem: How many flags were on the classroom string before the children added 14 more, if the string now has 32 flags? The classroom has a big map on the wall.
follow_up_questions: Then 5 flags fell off. How many flags are still on the string?
The teacher gave 8 flags to another class. How many flags are left on the string?

problem: Snow was on its way, so Mrs. Moreau hurried to chop firewood. By lunch she had filled 23 baskets. In the afternoon her neighbours came to help, and together they filled 16 more baskets. When the snow began, how many baskets were full?
follow_up_questions: Her shed can hold 50 baskets. How many more baskets could fit in the shed?
She stores the full baskets and gives 15 of them to the village hall. How many full baskets are left in the shed?
She gives half of those baskets to her sister. How many baskets does her sister get?

problem: How many crates of oranges were packed when the market closed? The packers filled 23 crates before lunch and 16 crates after lunch.
follow_up_questions: The lorry holds 50 crates. How many more crates could it take?
The crates are loaded and 15 are dropped off at a shop. How many crates are still on the lorry?
Half of those crates go to a school. How many crates does the school get?

problem: The ski lodge rents out sledges. On Thursday it had 36 sledges in the shed. Before the snowy weekend a truck delivered more, and now the lodge has 82 sledges altogether. How many sledges did the truck deliver?
follow_up_questions: Over the weekend 58 sledges were rented out. How many sledges are still in the shed?

problem: Altogether there are 82 bottles of sun cream in the beach shop now. There were 36 on Tuesday, before the new boxes arrived. How many bottles came in the new boxes?
follow_up_questions: During the heatwave, 58 bottles were sold. How many bottles are left?

problem: A few fishermen were sitting on the pier. Later, a club of 15 young anglers walked onto the pier, and then 22 people were fishing there. How many fishermen were on the pier before the club came?
When 15 children from the summer camp came into the ice cream shop, there were 22 customers inside. How many customers were already in the shop?
Hira decorated a birthday cake with 24 sweets. Her brother found 18 more sweets in the 3 kitchen jars and pressed them into the icing. How many sweets are on the cake now?
follow_up_questions: Their dog licked off 9 sweets. How many sweets are still on the cake?
Hira wants 50 sweets on it. How many more sweets does she need?

problem: How many stars are on the classroom ceiling now? Mr. Bello stuck up 24 paper stars, and his 3 helpers added 18 more.
follow_up_questions: During the holidays, 9 stars fell down. How many stars are still on the ceiling?
Mr. Bello wants 50 stars up there. How many more stars must he stick up?

problem: A scientist counted 91 tunnels in an ant hill in September. In May there had been only 54. How many tunnels did the ants dig between May and September?
follow_up_questions: Heavy rain in October filled in 16 tunnels. How many tunnels were left open after the rain?

problem: How many bricks did the builders add to the wall this month, if it had 54 bricks at the start of the month and 91 at the end?
follow_up_questions: A truck backed into the wall and knocked out 16 bricks. How many bricks were still in the wall?

problem: Tariq had some carrots in a bucket for the horses. His sister pulled 12 more carrots from the garden, so now the bucket holds 30 carrots. How many carrots did Tariq have before his sister helped?
follow_up_questions: At the stable they fed 21 carrots to the horses. How many carrots are left in the bucket?
Tariq gave 4 of the leftover carrots to a pony next door. How many carrots does he take home?
At home he puts them in a basket that already has 6 carrots. How many carrots are in the basket now?

problem: How many seeds had Lucy saved before her grandmother gave her 12 more, if her seed tin now holds 30?
follow_up_questions: In spring she plants 21 of the seeds. How many seeds are left in the tin?
She gives 4 of the leftover seeds to a friend. How many seeds does she keep?
She tips them into a jar that already has 6 seeds. How many seeds are in the jar now?

problem: The drama club had 26 members in the autumn. After the holiday play, 9 more children joined because they enjoyed the show. The club meets on the school stage. How many members does the club have now?
follow_up_questions: For the next play, the members stand in 5 equal rows. How many members are in each row?
If 2 more members are added to every row, how many members will be in each row?

problem: How big is the swim team now, if it had 26 swimmers before the gala and 9 more signed up after it? The pool water was very cold.
follow_up_questions: The swimmers are split into 5 equal lanes for practice. How many swimmers are in each lane?
If each lane gets 2 more swimmers, how many swimmers will be in each lane?

problem: Ollie had built a tower of 27 blocks. He wanted it to reach the top of the table, so he kept stacking until there were 45 blocks. How many blocks did he add?
A paper chain had 45 links once Aisha finished it. Before she started adding links that day, it had 27. Find how many links she added.

At the town hall, a magic show was about to start. Some families had already sat down when 37 more people came in from the street, making 82 people in total. How many people were sitting before the crowd from the street arrived?
follow_up_questions: The hall has 90 seats. How many seats are empty?

problem: In total 82 fans were in the stands after a bus brought 37 more from the other school. How many fans were in the stands before the bus arrived?
follow_up_questions: The stands have 90 seats. How many seats are not taken?

problem: A farm had 12 lambs in its field. A neighbour who lives 6 kilometres away brought over 7 more lambs that needed a home. How many lambs were in the field after that?
follow_up_questions: In spring, other farms bought 11 of the lambs. How many lambs stayed on the farm?

problem: How many puppies are in the shelter's playroom, if 12 were already playing and the vet, who has worked there for 6 years, carried in 7 more?
follow_up_questions: On Sunday, families took home 11 of the puppies. How many puppies are left in the playroom?

problem: Rosa laid out 15 plates for her grandfather's birthday dinner. More relatives came than she expected, so she brought extra plates from the cupboard. In the end there were 24 plates on the table. How many plates did she bring from the cupboard?
follow_up_questions: Every plate had a guest, and each guest got 2 dumplings. How many dumplings were needed?
The cook had made 60 dumplings. How many were left after every guest got theirs?

problem: How many mats did the coach fetch from the store room, if he had put out 15 mats for gym class and ended up with 24 mats on the floor?
follow_up_questions: Every mat got 2 beanbags. How many beanbags were needed?
The store room had 60 beanbags. How many were left in the store room?

problem: Now 83 bean shoots are growing in Mr Ito's field, and 47 of them came up in the second week. How many came up in the first week?
Find how many lambs were born in the first week of spring, if 47 more were born in the second week and the farm now has 83 new lambs.

After the morning classes took theirs, the gym teacher had only 18 balls left in the cupboard. Then the afternoon class came back from the field and returned 9 balls. How many balls are in the cupboard now?
follow_up_questions: Each team gets 3 balls. How many teams can the cupboard supply?

problem: How many paddles are on the rack now? Only 18 were left after the first canoe group set off, and then the second group came back and returned 9 paddles.
follow_up_questions: Each group of paddlers gets 3 paddles. How many groups can the rack supply?

problem: Sam collects stones on the beach near his home. When he left the house, his pocket held 8 stones from yesterday. When he came back, it held 25. How many stones did he pick up on this walk?
follow_up_questions: He paints 10 of them to look like ladybirds. How many stones are not painted?
He gives 6 unpainted stones to his neighbour. How many unpainted stones does he have left?
How many stones does Sam have now, painted and unpainted together?

problem: How many leaves did Aria collect at the park today, if her scrapbook had 8 leaves from yesterday and now has 25?
follow_up_questions: She colours 10 of the leaves with glitter. How many leaves have no glitter?
She gives 6 leaves without glitter to her teacher. How many leaves without glitter does she have left?
Counting leaves with and without glitter, how many leaves does Aria have now?

problem: A sailing school pushed 28 more boats onto the lake on a breezy morning, and then 63 boats were sailing. The ducks stayed close to the shore. How many boats were sailing before the school arrived?
follow_up_questions: The wind died down and 17 boats came back to shore. How many were still sailing?
When the wind blew again, 9 boats went back out. How many boats were sailing then?

problem: How many balloons were floating over the field before the balloon club launched 28 more, if 63 balloons were in the sky afterwards? The grass was still wet with dew.
follow_up_questions: Then 17 balloons landed. How many were still floating?
Later, 9 balloons took off again. How many balloons were floating then?

problem: Fourteen turtles were sunning themselves on a log. As the afternoon got warmer, 8 more turtles climbed up beside them. The log was 2 metres long. How many turtles were on the log then?
follow_up_questions: A canoe paddled past and 5 turtles slid into the water. How many turtles stayed on the log?

problem: How many pigeons were on the station roof after 8 more flew up to join the 14 already there? The roof is 2 floors above the platform.
follow_up_questions: A train whistle scared 5 pigeons away. How many pigeons stayed on the roof?

problem: Zara's pencil case had 6 coloured pencils at the start of the year. Before the art project she bought a new set at the school shop, and now she has 18 coloured pencils. How many pencils were in the set?
follow_up_questions: She lost 3 pencils on the bus. How many pencils does she have now?
Her friend borrowed 5 pencils. How many pencils are still in Zara's case?

problem: What number of stickers came in the new pack, if Luis had 6 stickers on his skateboard before and has 18 on it now?
follow_up_questions: Three stickers peeled off in the rain. How many stickers are left on his skateboard?
He peels off 5 old stickers to make space. How many stickers are on the skateboard now?

problem: Players were warming up on the football pitch before the match. When the whistle blew, 11 more players ran on in their boots, and now 26 players are on the pitch. The cup final is in 3 weeks. How many players were warming up before the whistle?
follow_up_questions: The coach has 30 water bottles. How many bottles are not used if each player gets one?

problem: How many dancers were practising in the hall before the dance teacher arrived with 11 more, if there are now 26 dancers and the show is 3 days away?
follow_up_questions: The hall has 30 mats. If each dancer uses one, how many mats are left over?

problem: The bakery's cooling rack had 45 loaves on it. Then the bakers took 38 more loaves out of the oven and set them on the rack. How many loaves are on the rack now?
follow_up_questions: Mrs Ruiz carried 29 cool loaves to the front shop. How many loaves are still on the rack?
In the shop, 4 of those loaves got squashed. How many of the loaves in the shop are not squashed?
The loaves that are not squashed go back on the rack. How many loaves are on the rack now?

problem: What is the number of paintings drying in the hallway now, if 45 were already drying and the second grade hung up 38 more?
follow_up_questions: The teacher took 29 dry paintings to the hall for the art show. How many paintings are still in the hallway?
At the show, 4 of those paintings got torn. How many paintings in the show did not get torn?
After the show, the paintings that did not get torn are hung back in the hallway. How many paintings are in the hallway now?
